title: Direct Recruitment to various posts in Government of India
body_text:
UPSC invites applications from eligible candidates for direct recruitment to various posts in Government of India.
2. The detailed Special Advertisement No. 52/2026 , along-with instructions to the candidates has been uploaded on the Commission’s website https://upsc.gov.in . Interested candidates can apply through the Online Recruitment Application portal https://upsconline.nic.in/ora/ from 22nd August, 2026 to 11th September, 2026.
3. Candidates are requested to follow the detailed instructions mentioned therein.
*******
NKR/AV

enrichment.summary: UPSC has released Special Advertisement No. 52/2026 inviting applications for direct recruitment to various posts in the Government of India. Eligible candidates can apply online through the Online Recruitment Application (ORA) portal between 22nd August and 11th September, 2026. Detailed instructions and vacancy information are available on the UPSC website.
enrichment.context: UPSC periodically issues special recruitment advertisements to fill various Group A and Group B posts in central government ministries and departments through direct recruitment, separate from its major examinations like Civil Services, CDS, or NDA. These notifications are routine administrative announcements providing procedural details such as application windows, eligibility criteria, and portal links for interested candidates.
